SELECT 
    fished_date_doy,
    cls,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2 
  AND fished_date_doy >= 50
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy DESC, cls;

SELECT 
    fished_date_doy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy;

SELECT 
    fished_date_doy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats,
    COUNT(*) as num_trips,
    SUM(yt) as total_yt,
    ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 1
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 20;

trips_s1['yt_per_angler'] = trips_s1['yt'] / trips_s1['anglers'].clip(lower=1)

# Group by day and class

}).reset_index()

SELECT 
    fish_date_doy,
    fish_date_season,
    cls,
    COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats
FROM schedule
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 270
  AND fish_date_doy <= 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;
